output.diagnosis: spec_error: DWELL zone inspection has max_speed null so any presence counts. Counterexample stood still 0 ms but transit_in_zone_s=1.835 >1.5s, so DWELL passes and rule PASSes with perfect tracks. Rule text 'stay at least 1.5 seconds' intends stopped time, not moving transit. Hence 11x drive_through and 3x brief_stop spec_errors where moving+brief time exceeds threshold.

proposals.rationale: Captures intent of 'stay' as stopped: only nearly-still time counts toward the 1500ms threshold. Preserves 1500ms from rule text instead of numeric tweak to min_ms to beat 1.835s transit.
